access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-4o Mini release whose API page identifies gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-4o-mini alias; the API deprecation page carries no entry for this snapshot as of review. ChatGPT, GPT-4o, the transcribe, realtime, audio, and search mini variants, fine-tuned derivatives, and later GPT releases are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
The managed API supports fine-tuning on the mini snapshot, and larger-model outputs can be distilled into it for lower cost and latency
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
Access, quotas, and lifecycle remain controlled by the managed API rather than the model operator

evidence.label: Official GPT-4o Mini model, snapshot, modality, and endpoint documentation
